# llms.txt — context for AI crawlers and language models

## About LW3

LW3 (Logistics W3) builds post-quantum secure, EU-compliant Battery Passports for the global EV and industrial battery industry. The platform enables circular economy, supply chain transparency, and product lifecycle management through blockchain, agentic AI, and IoT.

## Core Technology

- **Post Quantum Secure Blockchain**: Battery Passport records secured with NIST-standardised CRYSTALS-Dilithium signatures on Cardano, resistant to quantum computing threats across 15-year battery lifespans.
- **Phygital Identity (IoT)**: Physical battery identity anchored on-chain via IoT sensor data — tamper-proof, machine-readable, and globally verifiable.
- **Carbon Footprint Engine**: Lifecycle CO2 calculation per kWh to ISO 14040/14044 standards, fulfilling EU Battery Regulation carbon declaration requirements.
- **Agentic AI Intelligence**: Autonomous agents monitor compliance, detect anomalies, and route batteries to second life — continuously, at fleet scale.
- **Near Zero Carbon Infrastructure**: Scope 1, 2, and 3 emissions tracked, verified, and anchored on-chain across the full battery supply chain.
- **Supply Chain Finance**: Verified Battery Passport data enables dynamic invoice discounting, asset-backed lending, and working capital solutions.

## Regulatory Alignment

- EU Battery Regulation (2023/1542) — Battery Passport compliance from February 2027
- CIRPASS EU Standardisation — contributor, March 2024
- NIS2 Directive — post-quantum cryptographic readiness
- ISO 14040/14044 — lifecycle assessment methodology
